title: 第10章 铜牌
content_zh:
李瑕一行人二十三人渡过了长江之后，又走了四天，到达庐州。
庐州差不多是后世的合肥市，在如今是颇为重要的战略重镇。
从其位置就可以看得出来，北边是淮河，南边是长江，被称为“淮右襟喉”。
他们出发以来遇到城池都是绕过，这次到了庐州，聂仲由则决定进城。
因是扮成商队，他们在城门口交了一次过税，进了城之后又交了一次住税，两次数目都不小。
李瑕看得出来，聂仲由对庐州城有一种别样的感情，好几次抬起头注视着城墙的时候，眼睛里都流露出某种追忆的神情，手还下意识着抚摸着脖颈处的一道伤疤。
那是一道陈年老疤，大概是聂仲由几年前在这里打过仗……
他们在城中寻了一名客栈住下，包了一个院子，屋子并不算多，三三两两的共住一间。
李瑕运气不好，被分到与聂仲由同住。但想到林子、白茂的运气更差，是与呼噜声震天动地的刘金锁同住，他也就释然了。
进了客栈，聂仲由先是交代韩承绪与林子去采买一些物资。
因吴德贤死了，如今是由韩承绪出面假扮商队的领头，一路上的琐事都是由他出面办事，祖孙二人的待遇也因此好了许多。
交代完这些事，聂仲由又转头对李瑕道：“你陪我出门一趟，办件事。”
经过了长江水匪之事，聂仲由似乎对李瑕添了几分信任，有时遇事会与他商量，平素说话办事也都带着他，似乎有意把李瑕培养成为能代替蒋兴的副手。
两人兜兜转转，在城内绕了好一会，终于到了一间普通民宅前。
聂仲由显然也没来过这里，只知道地址，敲门时显得有些犹豫。
不一会儿，小宅子的门被
“敢问此处可是高家？”聂仲由问道。
那老者盯着聂仲由看了半晌，并不开口说话，不知是年纪太大反应慢，还是在打量来客。
聂仲由想了想，掏出一枚铜制令牌，在老者面前亮了亮，又低声道：“是吕太尉让我来的。”
“你们找错人了。”

那老者看起来糊里糊涂的样子，缓缓说了一句之后就要关上门。
聂仲由一愣，又问道：“此处是长丰巷吗？”
然而，那老者已毫不犹豫把门关上。
聂仲由又回过头张望了一会，确定了自己没找错地方，眼中浮现起沉思之色。
李瑕默默看着这一幕，又感到有哪里不对，心里暗自警惕起来。
两人这算是白跑了一趟，但回去的路上，李瑕隐隐感到有种被人窥探之感。
他正想回过头看一眼，忽听聂仲聂低声说了一句。
“别回头，就当没发现。”
李瑕此时才确定果然是被人跟踪了。
他倒也心大，一会儿后就指着路边卖鸡蛋的一个摊贩，问聂仲由能不能把鸡蛋全买下来。
聂仲由答应了，不仅连带篮子把鸡蛋买了，还特意买了只母鸡。
这个过程中李瑕没回头看，但聂仲由似乎在不易察觉地时候往后边看了一眼。
回到客栈，聂仲由显得有些踌躇，来回踱步了一会，看着李瑕的眼睛，道：“你父亲在我手上。”
这句话莫名其妙的，但李瑕竟然也能明白聂仲由的想法。
一天到晚的就知道威胁人。
“我知道。”李瑕道：“我既然答应替你办事，会说话算话。”
聂仲由继续盯着李瑕看了一会，似在思考他值不值得信任，末了，道：“你能猜到我们这次去开封，目的是什么吗？”
“猜不到……”
忽然，外面有脚步声敲起，接着伴随着敲门声，林子道：“哥哥，有人找你，自称陆凤台，说是你的故交。”
聂仲由似有一瞬间的恍神，喃喃道：“陆凤台？”

陆凤台走进客房。
他是个三十出头的中年男子，高挑壮硕，一看就是军伍之人，虽身着布衣，但有种不怒自威的气势。
见到聂仲由，陆凤台展颜笑了笑，道：“快十年未见了吧？”
“是。”聂仲由道：“十年未见了。”
陆凤台伸出手，在林子肩上拍了拍，道：“小兄弟，你不必这么防备我。当年我与聂兄在曾这庐州城追随杜相公拼死守城，乃生死之交。”
林子本来站在门边一副戒备的模样，被这么一拍，整个人的气势就弱了下来。
内心不坚定、气场不强大，所以甫一见面就被人镇住。
接着，陆凤台目光落在李瑕身上，微微一凝才转开，向聂仲由道：“私下聊两句？”
不等聂仲由回答，他自然而然又道：“你们先退下。”
林子眼中闪过些为难之色，显得略微有些局促。
李瑕却还是很坦然，也没有出去的意思。
他刚穿越过来，还带着把一切当成游戏的心态，眼前的陆凤台再有气场在他眼中也算不上什么人物。
何况这个客房是他与聂仲由共住，他是半个主人，怎么也不该是他出去。
聂仲由向林子使了个眼神，示意林子出去守好客院，又对李瑕道：“正好，陆兄来了，你也留下来听听，免得有些事我还得从头和你再说一遍。”
“好。”
陆凤台再次打量了李瑕一眼，也不介意，转头对聂仲由道：“今日你去过长丰巷？”
“是，那老头是你的人？”
“是，那枚令牌给我看看吧。”
“长丰巷，我要找的人呢？”
陆凤台道：“先给我看看。”

聂仲由也不避讳，掏了那令牌放在陆凤台眼前让他看了一眼，问道：“人呢？”
陆凤台看了一会，显然看不懂上面的文字，摇了摇头问道：“你要找的人是谁？”
“你明知故问，人不是被你捉了？”
“我真不知道。”陆凤台道：“我只知道那是从北面逃过来的人，我需要找到他们，交还给蒙古。”
聂仲由收起令牌，想了想，应道：“大理国，高氏。”
陆凤台微微一愣，似恍然大悟了，又像是还有些不解。
聂仲由看了李瑕一眼，见李瑕也有不解，干脆解释起来。
“陆兄也知道，自金国被灭以后，蒙古多次试图攻取我大宋四川之地，意图占据长江上游，以伐临安。幸有四川军民一力奋战，又仰仗余都帅沤心沥血辛苦经营，屡挫蒙军。”
话到这里，聂仲由向西南方向一拱手，神色肃穆。
“不错。”陆凤台亦是一拱手，表示对那位“余都帅”的敬仰。
聂仲由方才继续说道：“蒙军取四川不成，于是决定绕道川西高原攻取大理国。借西南的人力物力，形成对我大宋的迂回攻势。”
陆凤台道：“我知道蒙军灭了大理国，但隔得太远，不知具体详情。”
聂仲由道：“大理乃西南边陲小国，国主是段氏。而高氏则是白族首领，世代为大理国宰相，或者说是摄政宰相。
百年以前，大理国曾有过一场政变，段氏将国主之位禅让于高氏，改国号为大中。后来由于各部族反对，高氏后人又拥立段氏为皇帝，然而，高氏依然掌握大理实权。
五年前，蒙军攻破大理，时大理宰相高泰详极力主战，杀蒙古招降使者以示抗蒙决心，后来，他兵败被俘，引颈受戮。”
陆凤台道：“如此看来，此人虽是权臣，却也是忠烈之士。”
“高泰祥有气节，那大理国主段兴智却毫无骨气。”聂仲由道：“大理国灭之后，段兴智投降了，蒙哥封他为大理总管。
段兴智捡了条命，对蒙古感恩戴德，便替蒙军充当向导追杀大理残余兵马，镇压反抗蒙军的各族百姓。
我朝战马多来自大理，经此，亦失了战马来源。
大理本为我大宋臣邦，如今却成蒙古之鹰犬，对我大宋形成南北挟制。

从此，蒙军可避免在江淮水战、四川山地战，而绕到我们防御单薄的两广之地，挥军北上从西南方向包抄夹攻我大宋腹地。”
陆凤台问道：“聂兄在找的人，与那大理宰相高泰详有关？”
“是。高泰详死后，蒙军将他的幼子高琼带回了北面。”聂仲由道：“西南局势急迫，朝廷调吕太尉坐镇西南。去岁，有白族人联络吕太尉，请求大宋助其起事抗蒙。
吕太尉于是得知，有高氏余部北上意图救回高泰祥之幼子、以号召大理各族。但他们在北面的行动失败了，只好逃到我大宋境内，吕太尉便派人把他们安置在庐州。
我此次正好要北上，见他们一面可以顺便了解北面的情况，甚至替他们把高琼带回来。”
陆凤台沉默了一下，道：“原来如此。”
“陆兄与此事有何关联？”
“蒙古人派使者来庐州讨要逃犯。”陆凤台道：“我根据线索找到那间宅子，可惜晚了一步，人已经走了。于是我留下人手守株待兔，没想到等到了聂兄你。”
“你要把他们交还给蒙古？”
“是。”
聂仲由问道：“现在我已告诉陆兄他们是谁，你还要这么做？”
“是。”陆凤台道：“眼下形势微妙，绝不能让蒙古拿到把柄与我大宋宣战。”
“可笑。”
“你们这样做很危险，而且亳无意义。”陆凤台道：“大理国已经被灭了，一点白族义军、一点高氏后人根本什么也做不了。我们没有功夫去管一个边陲小国的命运，我们自己的危机已经迫在眉睫了。这种紧要关头，小心翼翼地维持盟约尚未不得，你们这么做，一旦轻启边衅……”
“轻启边衅？”
聂仲由显然不喜欢这个词，眉头一皱，语气登时不悦。
“陆兄怎会不明白这道理？只要蒙军想南下，我们再小心翼翼地维持盟约也不会有用。”
“我知道，但淮南两路都还没准备好。”
“准备？”聂仲由反问道：“十年前我们在庐州拼死守城的时候准备好了吗？十年了，你现在说没准备好？准备什么？你们没准备好为国捐躯是吗？”
content_en:
After Li Xia and his party of 23 people crossed the Yangtze River, they walked for another four days and arrived in Luzhou.
Luzhou is almost the Hefei City in later generations, and it is a very important strategic town today.
It can be seen from its location that it is bounded by the Huaihe River in the north and the Yangtze River in the south. It is called the "Huaiyou Breeze".
Since they set out, they had always bypassed the cities they encountered. This time when they arrived in Luzhou, Nie Zhongyou decided to enter the city.
Because they were disguised as a caravan, they paid a tax at the city gate and another residence tax after entering the city, both times the amount was not small.
Li Xia could tell that Nie Zhongyou had a different kind of feeling for Luzhou City. When he raised his head and stared at the city wall several times, there was a look of reminiscence in his eyes, and his hand subconsciously touched a scar on his neck.
It was an old scar, probably because Nie Zhongyou fought here a few years ago...
They found an inn in the city to stay in and rented a courtyard. There were not many rooms, so they lived in twos and threes.
Li Xia was unlucky and was assigned to live with Nie Zhongyou. But he was relieved when he thought that Lin Zi and Bai Mao had even worse luck, living with Liu Jinsuo, who snored loudly.
After entering the inn, Nie Zhongyou first asked Han Chengxu and Lin Zi to buy some supplies.
Because Wu Dexian died, it was now Han Chengxu who pretended to be the leader of the caravan. He was responsible for all the trivial matters along the way, and the treatment of the grandfather and grandson was much better as a result.
After explaining these things, Nie Zhongyou turned to Li Xia and said, "Please accompany me out to do something."
After the Yangtze River water bandits incident, Nie Zhongyou seemed to have a little more trust in Li Xia. Sometimes he would discuss things with him and take him with him when talking and doing things. He seemed to intend to train Li Xia to become a deputy who could replace Jiang Xing.
The two of them walked around the city for a long time, and finally arrived in front of an ordinary house.
Nie Zhongyou had obviously never been here before. He only knew the address and seemed a little hesitant when he knocked on the door.
After a while, the door of the small house was covered with quilt
"Dare I ask if this is the Gao family?" Nie Zhongyou asked.
The old man stared at Nie Zhongyou for a long time without speaking. He didn't know whether he was too old or slow to react, or he was sizing up the visitors.
Nie Zhongyou thought for a while, took out a copper token, showed it in front of the old man, and whispered: "It was Taiwei Lu who asked me to come."
"You've got the wrong person."
The old man looked confused and said something slowly before closing the door.
Nie Zhongyou was stunned and then asked: "Is this Changfeng Lane?"
However, the old man closed the door without hesitation.
Nie Zhongyou turned around and looked around for a while to make sure he was looking in the right place, with a look of contemplation in his eyes.
Li Xia watched this scene silently, and felt something was wrong, and secretly became wary.
It was a wasted trip for the two of them, but on the way back, Li Xia vaguely felt like he was being spied on.
He was about to look back when he suddenly heard Nie Zhongnie whisper.
"Don't look back, just pretend you didn't notice."
Only then did Li Xia confirm that he was indeed being followed.
He was quite generous, and after a while he pointed to an egg vendor on the roadside and asked Nie Zhongyou if he could buy all the eggs.
Nie Zhongyou agreed. Not only did he buy the eggs in a basket, but he also bought a hen.
Li Xia didn't look back during this process, but Nie Zhongyou seemed to glance behind him unnoticeably.
Back at the inn, Nie Zhongyou seemed a little hesitant. He paced back and forth for a while, looked into Li Xia's eyes and said, "I have your father in my hands."
This sentence is inexplicable, but Li Xia can actually understand Nie Zhongyou's thoughts.
He knows how to threaten people all day long.
"I know." Li Xia said, "Since I promised to do things for you, I will keep my word."
Nie Zhongyou continued to stare at Li Xia for a while, as if thinking about whether he was trustworthy. Finally, he said: "You can guess that we are going to Kaifeng this time.What's the purpose? "
"Can't guess..."
Suddenly, there were footsteps outside, followed by a knock on the door, Lin Zi said: "Brother, someone is looking for you, calling himself Lu Fengtai, saying he is your old friend. "
Nie Zhongyou seemed to be dazed for a moment and murmured: "Lu Fengtai? "
Lu Fengtai walked into the guest room.
He is a middle-aged man in his early thirties, tall and strong, and he looks like a soldier. Although he is dressed in civilian clothes, he has an aura of calmness and self-reliance.
Seeing Nie Zhongyou, Lu Fengtai smiled and said, "We haven't seen him for almost ten years, right? "
"yes. Nie Zhongyou said: "I haven't seen you in ten years." "
Lu Fengtai stretched out his hand, patted Lin Zi on the shoulder and said, "Little brother, you don't have to be so guarded against me. Back then, Brother Nie and I followed Du Xianggong in Zeng Luzhou City and defended the city to the death. We were close friends in life and death. "
Lin Zi was standing by the door with a guarded look, but after being slapped like this, his whole aura weakened.
His heart is not firm and his aura is not strong, so he is put down by others as soon as he meets him.
Then, Lu Fengtai's eyes fell on Li Xia, and he turned away for a moment, and said to Nie Zhongyou: "Let's talk in private? "
Without waiting for Nie Zhongyou to answer, he said naturally: "You guys stand down first. "
A look of embarrassment flashed in Lin Zi's eyes, and he looked a little embarrassed.
However, Li Xia was still very calm and had no intention of going out.
He had just traveled through time and still had the mentality of treating everything as a game. No matter how aura the Lu Fengtai in front of him was, he could not be considered a person in his eyes.
What's more, he and Nie Zhongyou shared this guest room. He was half the owner, so he shouldn't be the one to leave.
Nie Zhongyou glanced at Lin Zi, signaling Lin Zi to go out and guard the guest house, and then said to Li Xia: "Just in time, Brother Lu is here, you should stay and listen, lest I have to tell you some things from the beginning. "
"good. "
Lu Fengtai looked at Li Xia again and didn't mind. He turned to Nie Zhongyou and said, "Have you been to Changfeng Lane today? "
"Yes, is that old man yours? "
"Yes, show me that token. "
“Changfeng Lane, where is the person I’m looking for? "
Lu Fengtai said: "Show me first. "
Nie Zhongyou didn't shy away, took out the token, put it in front of Lu Fengtai's eyes, let him take a look, and asked: "Where is the person? "
Lu Fengtai looked at it for a while, obviously unable to understand the words above, shook his head and asked: "Who are you looking for? "
"You asked knowingly, wasn't he captured by you? "
"I really don't know. Lu Fengtai said: "I only know that they are people who escaped from the north. I need to find them and return them to Mongolia." "
Nie Zhongyou put away the token, thought for a while, and responded: "Dali country, Gao family. "
Lu Fengtai was stunned for a moment, as if he suddenly realized something, but also seemed a little confused.
Nie Zhongyou glanced at Li Xia and saw that Li Xia was also confused, so he simply explained.
"Brother Lu also knows that since the destruction of the Jin Kingdom, Mongolia has repeatedly tried to capture our land of Sichuan in the Song Dynasty, intending to occupy the upper reaches of the Yangtze River to attack Lin'an. Fortunately, the Sichuan soldiers and civilians fought hard and relied on Yu Dushuai's hard work and hard work to defeat the Mongolian army. "
Having said this, Nie Zhongyou cupped his hands toward the southwest with a solemn expression.
"Not bad. " Lu Fengtai also cupped his hands to express his respect for "Shuai Yu".
Nie Zhongyou just continued: "The Mongolian army failed to capture Sichuan, so they decided to take a detour to the Western Sichuan Plateau to capture the Dali Kingdom. Leverage the manpower and material resources of the southwest to form a roundabout offensive against our Song Dynasty. "
Lu Fengtai said: "I know that the Mongolian army destroyed the Dali Kingdom, but it was too far away and I don't know the specific details. "
Nie Zhongyou said: "Dali is a small country in the southwest border, and the leader of the country is the Duan family. The Gao family is the leader of the Bai tribe and has been the prime minister, or regent prime minister, of Dali for generations.
A hundred years ago, there was a coup in the Dali Kingdom. The Duan family abdicated the position of ruler to the Gao family and changed the country's name to Dazhong. Later, due to opposition from various tribes, the descendants of the Gao family supported the Duan family as emperor. However,, Gao still holds the real power in Dali.
Five years ago, the Mongolian army captured Dali. At that time, Dali Prime Minister Gao Taixiang took the lead in the battle and killed the Mongolian surrender envoys to show his determination to resist the Mongols. Later, he was defeated and captured, and was killed at the neck. "
Lu Fengtai said: "It seems that although this person is a powerful official, he is also a loyal and martyr. "
"Gao Taixiang has integrity, but Duan Xingzhi, the leader of Dali, has no spine. "Nie Zhongyou said: "After the destruction of Dali, Duan Xingzhi surrendered, and Meng Ge made him the general manager of Dali.
Duan Xingzhi saved his life and was grateful to Mongolia, so he acted as a guide for the Mongolian army to hunt down the remaining troops in Dali and suppress the people of all ethnic groups who resisted the Mongolian army.
Most of our war horses came from Dali. After passing here, we also lost the source of our war horses.
Dali was originally a vassal state of our Song Dynasty, but now it has become a Mongolian eagle dog, posing a threat to our Song Dynasty from the north to the south.
From now on, the Mongolian army can avoid water battles in the Jianghuai River and mountain battles in Sichuan, and instead go around our weakly defended areas of Guangdong and Guangxi, and send troops north to outflank and attack our Song Dynasty hinterland from the southwest. "
Lu Fengtai asked: "The person Brother Nie is looking for is related to the Dali Prime Minister Gao Taixiang? "
"yes. After Gao Taixiang died, the Mongolian army brought his youngest son Gao Qiong back to the north. "Nie Zhongyou said: "The situation in the southwest is urgent, and the imperial court transferred Taiwei Lu to take charge of the southwest. Last year, a Bai tribe member contacted Taiwei Lu and asked the Song Dynasty to help him fight against the Mongols.
Lieutenant Lu then learned that the remaining members of the Gao family were heading north with the intention of rescuing Gao Taixiang's youngest son and rallying all the tribes in Dali. But their operation in the north failed, and they had to flee to the Song Dynasty. Lieutenant Lu sent people to settle them in Luzhou.
I happen to be heading north this time. By meeting them, I can learn about the situation in the north and even bring Gao Qiong back for them. "
Lu Fengtai was silent for a moment and said, "That's it. "
"What does Brother Lu have to do with this matter? "
“The Mongols sent envoys to Luzhou to collect fugitives. Lu Fengtai said: "I found the house based on the clues, but it was a pity that it was too late. The person had already left." So I left my manpower to wait and see, but I didn't expect to see you, Brother Nie. "
“You want to hand them back to Mongolia? "
"yes. "
Nie Zhongyou asked: "Now that I have told Brother Lu who they are, you still want to do this? "
"yes. Lu Fengtai said: "The current situation is delicate. We must not let Mongolia get the leverage to declare war with the Song Dynasty." "
"Ridiculous. "
"What you are doing is dangerous and pointless. "Lu Fengtai said: "The Dali Kingdom has been destroyed, and the Bai rebels and the descendants of the Gao family can't do anything at all. We have no time to care about the fate of a small border country. Our own crisis is already imminent. At this critical juncture, it is not necessary to carefully maintain the alliance. If you do this, once you start provocation..."
"Qing Qingxian? "
